<!--
This is the most valuable issue type in the repo, and it needs no code, no repro
steps and no formatting. Prose is perfect. Fill in only the parts you have an
answer for and delete the rest — a single paragraph is a real contribution.
-->

**Which side of the table were you on?**
Interviewer / candidate / both. Roughly how many, and roughly when — hiring bars move.

**What does a real interview reward or punish that this tool misses?**

**Where is the rubric wrong?**
Too generous, too harsh, or measuring something interviewers do not actually care about.

**What would you have written in the debrief?**
In your own words, for a session like the one you saw. Even a couple of sentences helps —
the persona is tuned against exactly this.

**Anything the problem bank is missing**
Patterns you actually got asked, that are not in here.
